shared-host.contract: Existing shared host modules, tools, hooks and MCP logic; source reachability is not behavioral acceptance.

environment.contract: Host-owned effects, uploads into /workspace, browser downloads, clipboard and navigation.

server.contract: Pinned upstream settings HTTP requests; configured credential remains host-owned.
